decision: Keep as the current statically validated bare-model candidate. Raise only current-visible far, moderate compound-obstacle targets continuously from30 to at most36; preserve target30 for close obstacles, extreme curvature, strong steering and every detector miss. Do not claim a lap-time, clearance, completion, submission or SOTA improvement until an authorized paired driving evaluation passes the safety-first gate.

evidence.interpretation: The user feedback is supported as a localized compound-obstacle pace bottleneck, not as evidence for a blanket increase across all target speeds.

implementation: Route only bare state-dict inference through _AdaptiveCompoundTargetController; model.pt and explicit-export, DrQ and HAIC paths remain unchanged.
For a current recognized obstacle with6<=sweep<12, y<44 and final requested steering magnitude<=0.28, command target=30+6*clip((44-y)/12,0,1)*clip((12-sweep)/6,0,1).
Keep the stored compound latch target at30, so the first detector miss immediately restores command/effective target30.
Veto the uplift in the same frame when the final obstacle-adjusted steering request magnitude exceeds0.28.
Retain the existing softened compound brake envelope for every adaptive target31--36; target32 at speed40 emits brake0.13 versus control0.154 while preserving the inherited0.096 base-brake floor.
Keep near y>=44, extreme sweep>=12, noncompound sweep<6, detector miss1--4, fifth clear, clear curves/straights, steering, detection, reset, invalid input and road-loss behavior control-exact.

affected_local_submission_suite.command: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q tests/test_corridor_agent.py tests/test_agent_inference.py tests/test_local_contract.py tests/test_local_simulator_api.py tests/test_local_simulator_cli.py tests/test_local_simulator_diagnostic.py tests/test_local_simulator_environment.py tests/test_local_simulator_integration.py tests/test_local_simulator_run.py tests/test_local_simulator_schema.py tests/test_submission_policy.py tests/test_submission_package.py tests/test_submission_layout.py

static_validation.coverage: Exact distance, sweep and inclusive steering boundaries; four curve-direction/obstacle-side combinations; intermediate and maximum targets; first miss through release; reacquisition/flicker; far-to-near and increasing-severity transitions; reset, invalid and lost-road behavior;384 independent randomized cases and32 stateful randomized sequences all passed.
static_validation.independent_audit: Two read-only audits found no blocking implementation, MRO, latch, brake, boundary, state-restoration or protocol defect after the base hook placement and exact steering-boundary tests were corrected.

isolated_package.result: exact-file build/import/reset/action smoke passed; this is not an official Linux, driving or submission evaluation

residual_risks: The videos cannot expose policy-camera frames, internal obstacle row/sweep, detector state, physical speed or actions, so they do not prove which encounters qualify.
Target36 versus30 can materially increase directional kinetic demand; the distance, curvature and steering gates bound but do not prove future clearance safety.
Static same-input tests cannot establish closed-loop completion, collision/off-track non-regression, clearance or lap-time improvement.
SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf remain absent, so environment evaluation, promotion and submission remain blocked.
